The most enriched GO biological-process term CANNOT BE DETERMINED. No GO:BP annotation exists in the provided data — the gencode `ont` column is 100% empty (0/60,662 non-NA; raw file has 0 "GO:" and 0 "biological_process") and no gene2go/.gmt file exists anywhere on disk — and the sandbox has no internet, no R/clusterProfiler, and no gseapy, so GO:BP enrichment cannot be executed.

The DE pipeline was completed exactly as specified (artifacts.analysis = analysis.py, executed, exit 0): inner-join samples → dropped MGD1640F & MGD1641F → 14 samples (7 disease / 7 control); Ensembl(version)→symbol via gencode gene_name (60,662/60,662 mapped; HGNC cross-check 275 mismatches); row-sum≥10 filter (all gene types) → 31,149 genes; median-of-ratios size factors; statsmodels Poisson GLM (log link, offset=log(size_factor), design = C(condition)+C(sex)); BH FDR. Result: 13,162 genes significant at padj<0.05, of which 6,092 are up-regulated in disease. Top up-DE genes (significant, by log2FC): HOTAIR(+6.70), HOXC12(+6.11), HOXC11(+5.63), GABRA3(+5.18), MIR205HG(+5.16), AC012531.5(+5.03), UGT3A2(+4.95), AL121787.1(+4.77), HAUS1P3(+4.77), GRIK3(+4.73). GO:BP enrichment requires an external gene2go or .gmt annotation file to be completed.
